ruling: (a) Same as DEF-p3-appearance-302, which is already routed to character-manager: the ch006 CHORUS is the Duchess, with CHAR-cook and the baby joining (ch006-p37). CHAR-crowd-ensemble covers ch004 only. voiceprint's CHORUS mapping is consistent with this. (b) ch007-d0002: the same source sentence names the speakers ('the three were all crowded together ... they cried out', ch007-p02), so the speakers are CHAR-hatter, CHAR-march-hare and CHAR-dormouse, not UNKNOWN. (c) ch010-d0084: the source gives no speaker ('a cry ... was heard in the distance', ch010-p78). UNKNOWN is the correct parse and stays. voiceprint's use of CHAR-court-officers-ensemble is accepted as an inferred staging choice (off-screen herald cry). It is not canon, and 01-story/screenplay confirms or replaces it when it writes the line. None of this is creative enough to need a user ruling.
